notes.title: Update 0.86b
notes.content:
Added Content:

Map: Devil Desert
9 Races
6 Weapon Customizations
6 Impact Effects
3 Bullet Customizations
1 Color
Gameplay Additions:

Ability to change keyboard shortcuts in the options menu.
Added wind sound effects + visual acceleration effects.
Changes:

Removed black color on impact effects.
Slightly increased the hitbox of rings.
The behavior of the Rainbow color has been modified.
Items hovered over in the shop now slightly enlarge.
The restart button has been changed from "C" to "Space" by default.
Improved detection of certain blockages.
Fixes:

Passwords for private matches now work again.
Fixed an issue affecting accuracy when the player fired too quickly.
Invitations now directly lead to the lobby.
The money gain in Bounty Hunter mode is now correct.
The money gain in Wind Rider Fire Count mode is now correct.
Player usernames now display correctly in multiplayer.
Fixed a bug causing incorrect race mixing in multiplayer.
Fixed a freeze for the host in multiplayer Bounty Hunter mode.
In Bounty Hunter mode, a stuck player can now resume movement normally.
Added missing text in the tutorial.
